benchmark.schemaSql: CREATE TABLE customers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, ordered_at TEXT NOT NULL, total INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX idx_orders_filter ON orders(status, ordered_at, total);

columns.name: status
columns.expression: CASE WHEN row_number % 3 = 0 THEN 'paid' ELSE 'pending' END

title: [パフォーマンスチューニング][書いてみよう] JOINする前に対象をしぼる
statement:
customers と orders から、2026-05-01 以降の paid 注文のうち total が 1000 以上のものを表示してください。表示する列は order_id, customer_name, total。total の降順、order_id の昇順で並べます。

先に orders を絞り込み、その結果を customers と結合します。

constraints.name: 先にしぼる
constraints.value: orders から paid、日付、金額の条件に合う行だけを対象にします

constraints.name: JOIN
constraints.value: しぼった注文を customers とJOINして顧客名を表示します

starterSql:
WITH filtered_orders AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    customer_id,
    total
  FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'paid'
    -- 日付と金額の条件を追加します
)
SELECT
  filtered_orders.id AS order_id,
  customers.name AS customer_name,
  filtered_orders.total
FROM filtered_orders
JOIN customers
  ON customers.id = filtered_orders.customer_id
ORDER BY filtered_orders.total DESC, filtered_orders.id ASC;
solutionSql:
WITH filtered_orders AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    customer_id,
    total
  FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'paid'
    AND ordered_at >= '2026-05-01'
    AND total >= 1000
)
SELECT
  filtered_orders.id AS order_id,
  customers.name AS customer_name,
  filtered_orders.total
FROM filtered_orders
JOIN customers
  ON customers.id = filtered_orders.customer_id
ORDER BY filtered_orders.total DESC, filtered_orders.id ASC;
